# R15 total export and integration

R15 keeps transparent transition cels and adds opt-in native candidate review for the four Android character packages. No source asset replaces approved production art; runtime keeps original source atlas timing and anchor. Source right-facing clips only; ordinary movement remains authored fallback; no mirror, no fake diagonal directions. Review costumes may differ from game versions; never publish as production mapping until approved. Total offline export partitions all 991 catalog entries (826 character models, 98 effect models, 67 summon/skin). Pinned metadata ZIPs contain atlas/skeleton definitions, not texture images. Public texture retrieval only, failed files HOLD. The derived region renderer is used offline only; unsupported mesh/IK/deform/draw-order data are held for a more accurate converter or manual frame render. No rig in Godot. No merge, no combat-engine or progression changes. CI artifact export is not equivalent to public Web game integration. Confirm rights before redistribution.
